AIESEC in RMIT is an RMIT student club (Academic & Professional; Leadership / International / Youth). AIESEC is the world's largest youth-led organization, present in over 120 countries and territories, with a mission to achieve peace and the fulfillment of humankind's potential. Founded in 1948, it is a non-political, independent, not-for-profit entity run entirely by youth for youth. More about AIESEC: https://aiesec.org/ More about AIESEC in Australia: https://aiesecaustralia.org/ Who can join: Current RMIT students aged 18+; RMIT alumni, staff, students from other universities and general public aged 18+ can join as associate members. Biosciences Society is an RMIT student club (Academic & Professional; Academic / Science / Biology). RMIT’s Biosciences Society is here for all science students. Whether you’re studying biomed, biotech, or have a casual interest in the biological sciences, we’re here for you! We strive to provide safe, warm and welcoming events for you to have fun with your friends while exploring your interest in the sciences. You’ll be able to: hear from industry leaders, learn important job-related skills, do fun science-based activities and meet like-minded people. Throughout the year, we aim to run a wide variety of events for you to gain industry exposure and have fun with your friends! Here’s a sneak peak at what we’ve done and what’s next: • Pub Crawl • Lab Coat Personalisation Art Workshop • Movie Night • Ethical Debates • Study Sessions • Industry Expo • Healesville Sanctuary Zoo Trip • Science Museum Trips • Become a member today and join us at our next event :-) Who can join: All science students and students with an interest in biological sciences. Campus: RMIT University – Melbourne. Email: rbs@rmit.edu.au. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rmitbiosciencesociety/. Club page: https://campus.hellorubric.com/?s=10706. Usual activity: Regular events throughout the year. Past and advertised activities include pub crawls, lab coat personalisation, movie nights, ethical debates, study sessions, industry expos, Healesville Sanctuary trips and science museum trips. Recent past events include Student2Student Networking + Afterparty, Mad Science Bash and Science n' Sizzle. Information last checked 2026-09-25.
